name: Mixer tail live Yaw Center Trim: override, settle, armed gate, restore
step: Check the tail page's live centre trim: sends, settle time, armed gating and restore
rationale:
Setup > Mixer > Tail sends Yaw Center Trim to the flight controller live while the
mixer override holds the tail, so the pilot can see the tail move. The write skips EEPROM,
but the trim is applied by the firmware at once, so a wrong send or a send while armed
moves a tail that is spinning.

The harness drives the real mixer_tail.lua through its hooks and pins: no trim before an
edit, one send after the settle time with its confirmation callbacks, nothing else while a
write is pending, a refused write kept and retried, no send while armed or not known to be
disarmed, and a restore of the saved trim on leaving without saving only while disarmed.

--self-test runs the same checks on two broken copies of the page (a write without its
callbacks; the armed gate reduced to isArmed == true) and requires both to go red.
